title: Miri Standard Lifecycle and Security Metadata
description: Schema for lifecycle.json - package identity, advisory sources, update check, and support status

miri_lifecycle_version.description: Version of this lifecycle metadata format

purl.description: Package URL including version - the join key for all advisory lookups

distribution.description: Which defaults apply: open source (public OSV, PyPI) or private/internal

registry.description: The index this artifact is published to (HTTPS required); mismatch with installed origin is a dependency-confusion signal

advisory_sources.description: Ordered list of OSV-compatible query endpoints authoritative for this package

type.description: osv: public OSV.dev; osv-internal: private endpoint serving OSV-schema records; osv-local: offline OSV database archive

ecosystem.description: OSV ecosystem name (e.g. PyPI); required when type is osv

url.description: Query endpoint URL, or path/URL of an offline database archive

authoritative.description: Whether this source is authoritative for advisories against the package itself (vs. its dependency tree only); defaults to true when omitted

type.description: pypi-json: PyPI JSON API; pep700-index: PEP 691/700 JSON simple index (public or private)

url.description: Where to learn the latest published version (HTTPS required)

status.description: Current support status of this package

supported_versions.description: PEP 440 version specifiers describing currently supported release lines

replacement.description: Purl of the successor package; required (a non-null purl) when status is deprecated or eol

security_policy.description: URL of the project's security policy / vulnerability reporting process (HTTPS required)

vex.description: URL of an OpenVEX / CycloneDX VEX document with vendor exploitability statements (HTTPS required)
